content: तर्पण {%a.%} [तृप्-णिच् वा ल्युट्] Satisfying, pleasing, refreshing. .{@-णम्@} .²1 Pleasing, satisfying. .²2 Satisfaction, pleasure. .²3 Satiety, fulness. .²4 One of the five daily Yajñas (performed by men), presenting libations of water to the manes of the deceased ancestors (पितृयज्ञ). .²5 Fuel for the sacred fire. .²6 Food. .²7 Filling the eyes with oil <ab>&c.</ab>
